name: Franz Liszt Academy of Music
summary: Budapest conservatoire where main-subject classes for BA instrument, voice and conducting majors run in English; entry is by audition.

ib.text: Your IB Diploma is the school certificate, but BA applicants need an official Hungarian translation of it. English: TOEFL iBT 60, IELTS 5.0 or Cambridge 154. The audition decides, not IB grades.

programmes.name: Piano
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with piano as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: Bach prelude and fugue, a classical sonata, a romantic and a 20th-century piece and an etude from memory, plus a new piece sent a month ahead.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Organ
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with organ as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: a trio from memory, a 16th-18th-century programme, and a Geneva psalm with figured bass and a Bach chorale, both given on the day.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Harpsichord
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with harpsichord as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: at least 25 minutes across styles (16th/17th-century, Bach, French, a Scarlatti sonata), with sight-reading and a short interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Accordion
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with accordion as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: 20-25 minutes from memory on a chromatic button accordion: a Scarlatti sonata, Bach prelude and fugue, a contemporary piece and a free choice.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Violin
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with violin as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: two Bach movements, an outer concerto movement and one etude (Rode or Gaviniès in 2026), all from memory.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Viola
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with viola as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: a three-octave scale and arpeggio, etudes, two Bach cello-suite or violin movements and an outer concerto movement.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Cello
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with the cello as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: a Bach suite prelude or two dances, a Popper or Piatti etude, a virtuoso piece and a fast concerto movement, without sheet music.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Double bass
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with the double bass as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: scales, two etudes, slow and fast sonata and concerto movements, and orchestral sight-reading.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Flute
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with flute as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: concert etudes, a slow and fast Baroque sonata movement, a pre-Mozart concerto from memory and a romantic or 20th-century piece.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Oboe
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with oboe as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: an etude (Mille or Nazarov), Telemann sonata movements, a Haydn or Hummel concerto piece and a romantic or 20th-century work.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Clarinet
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with clarinet as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: a Klose etude and one more, Weber's Concertino from memory, a contrasting piece, scales and sight-reading.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Bassoon
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with bassoon as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: scales, two contrasting etudes, slow and fast Baroque movements from memory, and a later movement.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: French horn
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with the French horn as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: two etudes (Maxime-Alphonse, Gallay), a classical concerto first movement with cadenzas, and a slow movement or piece.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Trumpet
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with trumpet as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: Böhme etude no. 12 and two pieces in different styles, one from memory.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Trombone
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with trombone as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: two etudes (Kopprasch, Blazhevich or Bordogni), a Baroque sonata or two solo movements, and a romantic or 20th-century piece.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Tuba
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with tuba as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: Kopprasch and Blazhevich etudes, a Telemann fantasia and a contrasting piece; sound range and physical capability are checked.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Harp
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with harp as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: a 20-minute programme with Baroque and 20th-century works, an etude, sight-reading and three orchestral excerpts.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Guitar
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with the classical guitar as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: three Bach movements, two Legnani caprices and two pieces from other eras.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Cimbalom
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with cimbalom as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: scales, two Bach movements, an Allaga etude, a pre-classical and a 20th-century piece and a harmonised folk song.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Percussion
programmes.about: Six-semester BA with percussion as your main subject, taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition plus solfège, music theory and piano.
programmes.ib: Audition: side drum, timpani, marimba (Bach cello-suite movements, Musser etude) and a multi-percussion set-up piece, plus sight-reading.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Orchestral Conducting
programmes.about: Six-semester BA in orchestral conducting at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition conducting set symphonic works, with hearing, harmony and piano tested.
programmes.ib: Audition: conduct Mozart, Beethoven 1 and Schubert 8 from memory. English only runs if 3 or more international students are admitted to the major.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Choir Conducting
programmes.about: Six-semester BA in choral conducting at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is an audition rehearsing and conducting a choir, with hearing, harmony and piano tested.
programmes.ib: Audition: conduct and rehearse Renaissance, Romantic and Kodály/Bartók choral pieces from memory; in person only. English needs 3 or more international admits.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

family.name: Conducting
family.differs: Choral repertoire rehearsed with a live choir; in-person exam only.

programmes.name: Classical Singing
programmes.about: Six-semester BA in classical singing taught in English at the Liszt Academy in Budapest; entry is a sung audition, with solfège, music theory and piano also examined.
programmes.ib: Audition: Baroque, Viennese classical, romantic and two Hungarian songs, sight-learning of a piece and a prose text, and a drama exercise.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in person, plus solfège, music theory and piano; online only if you live outside Europe. 2026 requirements; 2027 not yet published.

notes: EU citizens may also compete for state-subsidised places through Felvi, but those are registered as Hungarian-language; the English route is self-financed, at the fee shown, applied for directly.
Online entrance exams are not available to applicants living in Europe (2026 rule), so expect to audition in Budapest from June to early July.
Applying costs EUR 140 by bank transfer, non-refundable and paid once even if you apply for two programmes; non-instrumental majors run in English only with 3 or more international admits.
